builder_notes.pattern: 5-selector dep cluster shared across N handlers — identical dep arrays signal extraction
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: When 3+ useCallback blocks list the same 4+ state selectors in their dep arrays, they belong in a single hook reading selectors internally
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Same 4+ deps in 3+ callbacks = one hook.
builder_notes.stack_example: handleExportJSON, handleExportCSV, handleExportMarkdown all had [projectName, tierOrder, tierLabels, tierColors, tiers] — identical dep arrays exposed the cluster.

builder_notes.pattern: jsdom missing URL.createObjectURL — spyOn fails with 'Property does not exist'
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: jest.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL') fails in jsdom because the property isn't defined on the URL constructor
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Install via Object.defineProperty(URL, 'createObjectURL', { writable: true, configurable: true, value: jest.fn() }) before spy.
builder_notes.stack_example: useExportHandlers.test.ts:72-84: installURLStubs() defines the properties before mocking.

builder_notes.pattern: handleExport dispatcher pattern — switch delegating to per-format handlers belongs with its routes
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: A useCallback whose body is a switch calling other useCallbacks is a routing artifact; it follows its handlers
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: A router belongs with its routes.
builder_notes.stack_example: handleExport moved into useExportHandlers alongside onExportJSON, onExportCSV, onExportMarkdown.
